import { parseFen, toFen } from './fen.mjs'
import { inCheck, legalMovesOf, makeMove, toUci } from './movegen.mjs'

export function applyMove(fen, uci) {
  const pos = parseFen(fen)
  const move = legalMovesOf(pos).find(candidate => toUci(candidate) === uci)
  if (!move) throw new Error(`lance ilegal: ${uci}`)
  return toFen(makeMove(pos, move))
}

export function gameStatus(fen) {
  const pos = parseFen(fen)
  const check = inCheck(pos)
  if (legalMovesOf(pos).length === 0) return check ? 'checkmate' : 'stalemate'
  return check ? 'check' : 'ongoing'
}
